content: The mobile app release train ships every second Thursday, with the release candidate cut on the Monday before.
Production deployments for rantaiclaw_project happen on Friday afternoons after the freeze check passes.
rantaiclaw_user prefers the dark theme and a monospace font size of 14 in the code editor.
The daily standup is at 09:30 in the team channel and lasts fifteen minutes.
The analytics service stores events in PostgreSQL and keeps raw exports in object storage for ninety days.
Every pull request needs two approvals, and changes to billing code need a review from the payments owner.
rantaiclaw_user wants short answers first, with details only when asked.
Nightly database backups run at 02:00 UTC and are kept for thirty days.
The on-call rotation changes every Monday at 10:00, and the handoff note goes into the operations channel.
The travel budget for the conference trip is capped at 1200 dollars including the hotel.
The office cafeteria schedule: lunch is served from 12:00 to 13:30 on weekdays.
The mobile app icon uses a teal background with a white claw mark.
The staging environment is reset every night, so test data does not persist.
rantaiclaw_user listens to instrumental music while coding.
rantaiclaw_user writes commit messages and documentation in English.
The public API allows 100 requests per minute per token before returning a rate limit error.
The sprint retrospective happens every second Wednesday at 15:00.
The team laptop image includes Rust 1.92, Docker, and the internal VPN client.
The company holidays for next year are listed in the shared calendar. The winter break starts on December 24.
Any production incident needs a written postmortem within five working days.
Rilis aplikasi seluler keluar setiap Kamis minggu kedua, dan kandidat rilis dipotong pada hari Senin sebelumnya.
Deploy ke produksi dilakukan hari Jumat sore setelah pemeriksaan pembekuan kode lulus.
rantaiclaw_user lebih suka tema gelap dan ukuran font 14 di editor kode.
Standup harian dimulai pukul 09.30 di kanal tim dan berlangsung lima belas menit.
Layanan analitik menyimpan peristiwa di PostgreSQL dan menyimpan ekspor mentah selama sembilan puluh hari.
Setiap pull request butuh dua persetujuan, dan perubahan kode penagihan harus ditinjau pemilik pembayaran.
rantaiclaw_user ingin jawaban singkat dulu, rincian hanya jika diminta.
Cadangan basis data malam hari berjalan pukul 02.00 UTC dan disimpan selama tiga puluh hari.
Rotasi jaga berganti setiap Senin pukul 10.00, dan catatan serah terima ditulis di kanal operasi.
Anggaran perjalanan untuk konferensi dibatasi 1200 dolar termasuk hotel.
Jadwal kantin kantor: makan siang disajikan pukul 12.00 sampai 13.30 pada hari kerja.
Ikon aplikasi seluler memakai latar hijau tosca dengan logo cakar putih.
Lingkungan staging direset setiap malam, jadi data uji tidak bertahan.
API publik mengizinkan 100 permintaan per menit per token sebelum mengembalikan galat batas laju.
Hari libur perusahaan tahun depan ada di kalender bersama. Libur akhir tahun mulai 24 Desember.
Setiap insiden produksi butuh laporan pascainsiden tertulis dalam lima hari kerja.
Retrospektif sprint berlangsung setiap Rabu minggu kedua pukul 15.00.
Besok pagi rantaiclaw_user meninjau rencana sprint bersama tim.
